prompt.project_info: Create a realistic candid commuter photograph of an original approved adult woman using her phone inside a subway carriage.
prompt.main_subject: An original approved adult woman with long dark hair sits by the subway door looking down at a light-colored smartphone held in both hands. She wears a fitted gray long-sleeved top, dark casual bottoms, white sneakers, and has a black backpack resting across her lap.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical candid framing photographed from across the aisle, subject seated with legs crossed naturally, subway window and door frame, metallic seat and floor, black-and-yellow door safety strip, foreground passenger silhouette creating depth, and subtle carriage signage.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffuse fluorescent subway lighting, neutral gray and silver tones, realistic reflections and mild motion ambience, quiet unposed commuter mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Realistic smartphone photography, vertical 4:5, candid medium-full-body framing, natural perspective, moderate depth of field, slight handheld softness, visible fabric and metal texture, restrained color, no artificial HDR look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Realistic vertical 4:5 candid subway lifestyle photo of an original approved adult woman with long dark hair sitting by the train door and looking down at a light-colored smartphone held in both hands. She wears a fitted gray long-sleeved top, dark casual bottoms, white sneakers, and has a black backpack across her lap. She sits with legs crossed naturally inside a modern subway carriage. Metallic seat and floor, window, door frame, black-and-yellow safety strip, subtle signage, and a foreground passenger silhouette create depth. Soft fluorescent light, neutral gray and silver palette, realistic handheld commuter photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, childlike features, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, unsafe transit behavior, moving-door obstruction, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, unreadable signage
